title: Desert meeting with 'the boys upstairs': four descending lights that turned out to be Marine flares
place_text: Desert near Joshua Tree / Twentynine Palms, California

tellings.quote: And we're out in the desert late at night and we see my mouth dropped open. Four lights slowly descending.

plain: Jeffrey Mishlove, a researcher with a PhD who studies psychic claims, told the podcast host Jesse Michels about a night in the late 1970s in the desert near Joshua Tree and Twentynine Palms, California, where he went with a woman named Valerie Ransone to meet what was called "the boys upstairs." He says his mouth dropped open as four lights slowly came down from the sky. By his account, the lights turned out to be flares dropped by the Marines.
